appearance_facts.fact: There are five vertical bars arranged horizontally from left to right: Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, and Others.
The Huawei bar (crimson red) is the tallest, extending highest on the page, reaching a level above the 60 mark on the y-axis.
The Apple bar (orange) is the second tallest, reaching a level between the 30 and 40 marks on the y-axis.
The Others bar (blue) is the third tallest, reaching a level between the 20 and 30 marks on the y-axis.
The Xiaomi bar (green) is the fourth tallest, reaching a level just below the 50 mark on the y-axis.
The Samsung bar (dark blue) is the shortest, reaching a level just above the 0 mark on the y-axis.

printed_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Global Smartphone Market Share 2024'.
The vertical axis is scaled from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 10.
The label above the Apple bar is '30%'.
The label above the Samsung bar is '11%'.
The label above the Xiaomi bar is '11%'.
The label above the Huawei bar is '23%'.
The label above the Others bar is '25%'.
